{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check assay_batch
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
duplicates = data.groupby('patient_id').size().gt(1)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {duplicates.sum()}")

# Confirm that the data has the expected structure
print("\nFirst few rows:")
data.head()"}
